notes.winRate: Wins divided by wins plus losses; ties are tracked but excluded from win-rate denominator.
notes.metricEligibility: Metric calculations exclude standings marked invalid because required data could not be resolved, plus standings where the player dropped on game 1.
notes.usagePercent: Pokemon count divided by player records with public teams in this stats file scope.
notes.setUsagePercent: Set count divided by player records with public teams in this stats file scope.
notes.pokemonUsagePercent: Set count divided by that Pokemon total set count in this stats file scope.
notes.topAbilityItems: Ability plus item counts are grouped across all move combinations for that Pokemon.
notes.topAbilities: Ability counts are grouped across all items and move combinations for that Pokemon.
notes.topItems: Item counts are grouped across all abilities and move combinations for that Pokemon.
notes.detailMinimum: Top detail lists only include entries with at least 1% usage within their modal detail context.
